title: AI Code Generation Platform
description: Template for tracking the full user journey within an AI-powered code generation platform, from initial project creation and iteration to community engagement and premium feature adoption, leveraging insights from the gpt-engineer manifest.

milestones.title: Platform Discovery
milestones.description: User finds gpt-engineer through GitHub, website, or community channels.

milestones.title: Documentation Review
milestones.description: User explores the platform's features, capabilities, and use cases.

milestones.title: Installation Initiated
milestones.description: User starts the installation process (e.g., via pip or cloning repo).

milestones.title: First CLI Interaction
milestones.description: User runs a basic CLI command (e.g., `gpt-engineer --help`).

metrics.name: Website/Repo Visitor Count
metrics.howToMeasure: Unique visitors to the main website or GitHub repository per month.

metrics.name: Documentation Engagement Rate
metrics.howToMeasure: % of unique visitors who view 3+ documentation pages.

metrics.name: Installation Success Rate
metrics.howToMeasure: % of unique users initiating installation who successfully complete it.

metrics.name: First Command Execution
metrics.howToMeasure: % of installations that result in an initial CLI command execution.

milestones.title: Project Specification
milestones.description: User defines their first project idea in natural language.

milestones.title: Generation Attempted
milestones.description: User initiates the code generation process for a project.

milestones.title: First Successful Generation
milestones.description: User successfully generates runnable code for their first project.

milestones.title: Project Execution/Test
milestones.description: User runs or tests the generated project for the first time.

milestones.title: Project Deployed/Shared
milestones.description: User deploys their first project using the `--share` flag.

metrics.name: Time to First Generation
metrics.howToMeasure: Average time (minutes) from first CLI interaction to first successful code generation.

metrics.name: Generation Success Rate
metrics.howToMeasure: % of generation attempts that result in runnable code.

metrics.name: First Run Success Rate
metrics.howToMeasure: % of successfully generated projects that pass initial execution/tests.

metrics.name: First Share/Deployment Rate
metrics.howToMeasure: % of activated users who deploy their first project via `--share`.

milestones.title: Multiple Project Generations
milestones.description: User creates several projects beyond their initial one.

milestones.title: Iterative Improvement
milestones.description: User leverages `--improve`, `self-heal`, or `clarify_mode` for refinement.

milestones.title: Git Integration Usage
milestones.description: User commits generated code using built-in Git staging features.

milestones.title: Token Usage Monitoring
milestones.description: User reviews LLM token usage and cost for their projects.

milestones.title: Exploring CLI Features
milestones.description: User utilizes advanced CLI options and configurations.

metrics.name: Weekly Active Generators (WAG)
metrics.howToMeasure: Number of unique users generating code at least once a week.

metrics.name: Improvement Feature Adoption
metrics.howToMeasure: % of active users utilizing `--improve` or `self-heal` modes.

metrics.name: Git Integration Rate
metrics.howToMeasure: % of projects where Git staging features are used.

metrics.name: Average Token Spend
metrics.howToMeasure: Average LLM tokens consumed per active user per week.

milestones.title: Project Shared Publicly
milestones.description: User shares a project link, making it publicly discoverable.

milestones.title: Project Views Received
milestones.description: User's shared project receives views from others.

milestones.title: Remix Intent Tracked
milestones.description: Another user expresses intent to remix a shared project.

milestones.title: Project Remixed
milestones.description: Another user successfully remixes a project to create a new one.

milestones.title: Feedback Provided
milestones.description: User provides feedback on generated code or platform features.

metrics.name: Sharing Rate
metrics.howToMeasure: % of engaged users who publicly share at least one project.

metrics.name: Project View Conversion
metrics.howToMeasure: Average number of unique views per shared project.

metrics.name: Remix Conversion Rate
metrics.howToMeasure: % of remix intents that lead to a completed new project.

metrics.name: Community Feedback Rate
metrics.howToMeasure: Average number of feedback submissions per active user per month.

milestones.title: Managed LLM Service Adoption
milestones.description: User opts into gpt-engineer's managed LLM API service.

milestones.title: Premium Deployment Features
milestones.description: User enables custom domains or advanced deployment settings for their projects.

milestones.title: Premium Analytics Access
milestones.description: User accesses detailed project insights and analytics dashboards.

milestones.title: White-Label Branding
milestones.description: User removes 'Built with gpt-engineer' branding from deployed projects.

milestones.title: Collaborative Workspace Usage
milestones.description: User utilizes team collaboration features for shared projects.

milestones.title: Agent/Template Monetization
milestones.description: User publishes a specialized agent or template to the marketplace for monetization.

metrics.name: Premium Feature Adoption Rate
metrics.howToMeasure: % of engaged users subscribing to any premium feature.

metrics.name: Managed LLM ARPU
metrics.howToMeasure: Average revenue per user from the managed LLM service.

metrics.name: White-Label Conversion
metrics.howToMeasure: % of deployed projects upgraded to white-label branding.

metrics.name: Team Workspace Usage
metrics.howToMeasure: Number of active collaborative workspaces created per month.

metrics.name: Marketplace Creator Conversion
metrics.howToMeasure: % of users publishing a monetized agent/template to the marketplace.

metadata.framework_description: This template provides a Product-Led Growth framework for AI code generation platforms, specifically tailored for open-source tools evolving into marketplaces. It tracks the journey from initial discovery and first project success through advanced usage, community engagement, and eventual monetization avenues like premium services and marketplace contributions.
metadata.usage: Use this template to monitor user acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention within your AI development tool. Identify bottlenecks, prioritize growth initiatives based on feature adoption, and track the impact of community and monetization strategies. Customize milestones and benchmarks to match your product's unique value proposition and target user segments.
